reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current delete section already says deleted resources are absent from search, 410 is returned when the server wishes to indicate deletion, policy/security may require another AccessDenied response, successful deletion may return 200/204 or 202 when non-committal, and delete support is discretionary based on policy and business rules.
